units.text: INT. ABANDONED LANGUAGE LABORATORY - NIGHT
Forty carrels in rows, each with a dead headset hung on its hook like a tiny hanged man.
Cassette decks, dusty.
A reel-to-reel machine at the front of the room, its tape spooled out across the floor and into the dark.
DETECTIVE VERONICA OSEI-LAMBERT (40s, trench coat, a flashlight clamped in her teeth) steps between the carrels.
Behind her, DETECTIVE MARGUERITE ILLYICH (40s, long coat, notebook out) keeps one hand on the grip of her sidearm.
Neither speaks.
At the rear wall, a man sits slumped in a carrel, headset clamped on.
LEONARD ASHBY (50s, a gray cardigan), dead or sleeping.
His chest does not rise.
Veronica takes the flashlight from her mouth.
She said to look at the tape.
units.name: VERONICA

units.text: Who said?
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: She did.
units.name: VERONICA

units.text: Marguerite follows the loose tape with her eyes, from the reel-to-reel along the floor to Leonard's carrel, where it is fed through the deck beneath his hands.
Veronica leans over him.
She lifts the headset, holds it to her own ear.
A hiss.
A voice, thin and warm, from the earpiece.
If you are hearing this, then she has already left the building. She is on the third floor. She has the key. She is not alone.
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: Veronica pulls the headset off.
Marguerite has already turned to the door.
On the landing outside, slow footsteps climb, and a keyring chimes at every step.
She's early.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Who is?
units.name: VERONICA

units.text: Both of us, I think.
units.name: MARGUERITE
